messages:
Nadia: Heads-up, GreenLane Security returned the network section of the questionnaire and they ONLY accept static IP allowlists for the POC. They asked whether PrivateLink can meet that and what the quick firewall snippet is.
Ben: PrivateLink can work but we have to provision the interface endpoint and share the ENI EIPs afterwards. Note that AWS can rotate ENI EIPs during maintenance; for strict long-term stability peering or Dedicated is safer. For a short POC we typically accept the small risk.
Ishaan: Important operational detail: PrivateLink does not preserve original client source IP across our backend. If GreenLane needs src-IP preserved for downstream ACLs, peering or a Private deploy is required. Call that out in the questionnaire.
Lena: CMDB-friendly firewall JSON we can give them (fill in the EIPs after provisioning):
```json
{"name":"allow-greenlane-redwood","direction":"egress","proto":"tcp","ports":"443","dest":"<REPLACE_WITH_PROVIDED_EIP_OR_FQDN>","note":"TLS to Redwood PrivateLink endpoint. If only IPs allowed, use provided EIPs after provisioning."}
```
Ben: SNI note: some corp proxies do SNI-based allowlisting. Tell them to allow TLS SNI for the endpoint hostname (e.g., privatelink.us-west-2.api.redwood-inference.internal). If their proxy strips SNI, we'll need to discuss alternate topology.
Nadia: Pricing snippet for the questionnaire: PrivateLink = AWS interface endpoint hourly + AWS data processing per-GB + our small connectivity surcharge. VPC peering = no interface endpoint fee but potential cross-AZ/transfer charges and more setup time. Recommend PrivateLink for speed unless they need guaranteed IP stability or src-IP preservation.
Ishaan: Action items: (1) Confirm GreenLane accepts EIP allowlist and timeline, (2) infra to provision sandbox interface endpoint if they do, (3) Security to paste encryption/mTLS/logging bullets into the questionnaire.
Nadia: I'll ask GreenLane if they'll accept the post-provision EIPs and request their expected GB/day.
infra-bot: Ticket NET-20482 created to provision sandbox PrivateLink in us-west-2 for GreenLane POC. ETA 48 hours.
Lena: If GreenLane pushes for immutable IPs + src-IP preservation, escalate to me; we'll propose peering or a short Dedicated eval.
Nadia: Thanks team ":thumbsup:", will update when they reply.
